function: Jointly learns the phase-shift matrices and flight displacements of multiple UAV-IRS relays to maximize the downlink secrecy sum rate against eavesdroppers (p. 5, p. 6).
system: BS with K=20 antennas, 20 single-antenna users, 2 single-antenna eavesdroppers, 3 reflecting (passive) UAV-IRS with 15 elements each; direct link blocked; no frequency band stated (pp. 3-4, 11).
method: Multi-agent soft actor-critic (PD-CMASAC) with three-layer MLP actor and critics, centralized training with distributed execution, Shapley-value credit rewards, primal-dual constraint; online reinforcement learning (pp. 7-11).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician channels with path loss (rho 20 dB, xi 2.2, beta 10 dB), 1 km square, Gaussian-Markov user mobility; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Policies trained online over episodes in the same simulated setting (Fig. 3); results vary UAV, IRS-element and user numbers and CSI error, with no stated train-test split (pp. 11-13).
baselines: MASAC-TR, MASAC-IR, MASAC-RS (learned variants of the proposal); RPS random phase and FUP fixed position, each with the other variable learned by PD-CMASAC (pp. 11-12).
metrics: Cumulative average and sum secrecy rate (bit/s/Hz), cumulative cost of non-cooperative behaviour, Jain fairness index (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Training order O(N_epi T((N+M)N! + |B|(O_P+O_R+O_C))), individual-reward step O((M+N)N!); no measured runtime (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "We model the above channels as the Rician channel"; p. 11: "ρ = 20 dB, ξ = 2.2, β = 10 dB". Custom Rician simulator, with no 3GPP model, ray-tracing set or measurement.
q2_support: p. 12: "cumulative average security rate of users for the six algorithms versus the number of UAVs". Missing: the paper never says a trained policy is tested on a configuration unseen in training or adapted; p. 13 imperfect CSI is only a CSI-error sweep.
q3_support: p. 11: MASAC-TR agents "optimise their strategies directly using team reward as the learning reward"; the three MASAC baselines are the proposal without credit allocation or constraint. p. 12: "random phase shift (RPS)" is non-learned. Missing: no earlier published learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "the complexity of the training process of the scheme is OT = O(Nepi T ((N + M )N ! + |B|(OP + OR + OC )))".
q5_support: p. 11: "users and eavesdroppers move randomly following the Gaussian-Markov model" in a custom simulator with Table I parameters. Missing: no code, data or link is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Passes above_phy because the UAV trajectory is learned jointly with the IRS phase shifts (p. 6: an(t) = {dQnU(t), Theta_n(t)}). Area 6 by the precedence rule, since the learned control acts on aerial relays (UAV-IRS at 50-120 m, p. 11); area 3 also fits through the IRS phase shifts, so the reviewer may confirm. q3 borderline: MASAC-TR is plain MASAC, the base of the proposal, so it is treated as an ablation; if the reviewer counts it as a standard algorithm, q3 would be 1.
